final_message:
Fixed in `src/lru.py`. `get` never marked a key as recently used, so key 1 stayed first in line for eviction. It now moves the key to the most-recent position on a hit.

I ran your scenario after the change. `get(1)` returns `'a'`, `get(2)` returns `None` (it was evicted), and `get(3)` returns `'c'`. I didn't run any other tests.

`order` is still a list, so each `get` and `put` costs O(n). If you want O(1) operations, I can switch it to `collections.OrderedDict`.
